decisions.statement: A rule the pages already say is written again by nothing.
A rule page no rule wants any longer is taken away.
A rule whose place among the rules moved is written again.
An entry key is named where the rule has rows or where the page has rows.
An entry key named carrying no row empties the file beside the page.
A row is compared over the fields the write states rather than every field.
The id a landed row has is therefore no difference.
A key a rule drops is kept by the page.
A write merges onto the page.

definition: the rule pages a browser writes and takes away to make the pages say what it has
